description: This file contains mock classes and test utilities for testing eviction strategies and cache behavior in Orleans streaming with Event Hubs, including mock implementations of cache, eviction strategy, and pressure monitor.

classes.name: EventHubQueueCacheForTesting
classes.description: A test subclass of EventHubQueueCache for testing purposes, exposing ItemCount.

classes.name: EHEvictionStrategyForTesting
classes.description: A test subclass of ChronologicalEvictionStrategy, exposing inUseBuffers.

classes.name: MockEventHubCacheAdaptor
classes.description: A mock implementation of EventHubDataAdapter for testing, providing controlled stream position generation.

classes.name: CachePressureInjectionMonitor
classes.description: A mock implementation of ICachePressureMonitor for testing cache pressure scenarios.

classes.name: PurgeDecisionInjectionPredicate
classes.description: A subclass of TimePurgePredicate for testing purge decision logic.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Returns a StreamPosition with a generated sequence token based on input partition and message.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records cache pressure contribution; no-op in mock.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Returns whether the cache is under pressure based on internal flag.

methods.name: ShouldPurgeFromTime
methods.description: Determines whether to purge based on internal flag.
